name: RedDB
description: Computational database of 31,618 electroactive organic molecules (quinones and aza-aromatics) relevant to aqueous redox flow batteries, built via combinatorial library generation, quantum-chemical property calculation and ML solubility prediction. Emphasizes redox potentials and battery-performance descriptors.
associated_paper: Sorkun et al., 'RedDB, a computational database of electroactive molecules', Sci. Data 9:718 (2022)

name: QM9
description: Computed geometric, energetic, electronic, and thermodynamic properties (19 quantum-chemical properties at B3LYP/6-31G(2df,p)) for ~134k stable small organic molecules (up to 9 heavy atoms, CHONF) drawn from GDB-17. The foundational benchmark for geometric deep learning on molecules.
associated_paper: Ramakrishnan, Dral, Rupp, von Lilienfeld, Sci. Data 1:140022 (2014)

name: QM7 / QM8
description: QM7: 7,165 small organic molecules (up to 7 heavy atoms, from GDB-13) with Coulomb matrices and DFT atomization energies. QM8: TD-DFT/CC2 low-lying electronic excitation energies and oscillator strengths for ~21,786 molecules. Standard quantum-chemistry ML benchmarks hosted on quantum-machine.org.
associated_paper: Rupp et al., Phys. Rev. Lett. 2012 (QM7); Ramakrishnan et al., J. Chem. Phys. 143:084111 (2015) (QM8)

name: ANI-1x / ANI-1ccx
description: ~5 million off-equilibrium molecular conformations with DFT (wB97x/6-31G(d)) properties, generated via active learning; ANI-1ccx adds coupled-cluster (CCSD(T)) reference data. Designed to train transferable neural-network interatomic potentials for organic molecules.
associated_paper: Smith et al., The ANI-1ccx and ANI-1x data sets, Sci. Data 7:134 (2020)

name: TRI HTP-MD Polymer Electrolyte Database
description: HTP-MD (Toyota Research Institute with MIT), the largest open database of polymer electrolyte properties: ~6,286 high-throughput MD trajectories of amorphous polymer-LiTFSI systems (~5.7 TB) with computed Li-ion conductivity, diffusivity and transference number. Computational (MD), not experimental.
associated_paper: France-Lanord/Khajeh et al., APL Machine Learning (2023)

name: QMOF Database
description: Database of quantum-chemical properties (band gaps, charges, electronic structure) for 20,000+ metal-organic frameworks and coordination polymers, generated by high-throughput periodic DFT. Downloadable from Figshare and explorable via the Materials Project MOF Explorer.
associated_paper: Rosen et al., 'Machine Learning the Quantum-Chemical Properties of MOFs', Matter 4 (2021)

name: hMOF (Hypothetical MOF Database)
description: Database of ~137,000 hypothetical MOF structures generated by recombining building blocks (Wilmer et al. 2012), with GCMC-simulated gas adsorption isotherms (CH4, CO2, H2, N2, Xe/Kr) and textural properties. Hosted and distributed in bulk through MOFX-DB at Northwestern.
associated_paper: Wilmer et al., 'Large-scale screening of hypothetical metal-organic frameworks', Nat. Chem. 4 (2012)

name: MOFX-DB
description: Searchable database (Snurr group, Northwestern) of ~160,000 MOF and zeolite structures aggregated from CoRE MOF, hMOF, ToBaCCo, IZA and other sources, with millions of pre-computed GCMC adsorption isotherms for CH4, CO2, H2, N2, Xe, Kr and H2O plus textural properties. Bulk downloads and a REST API.
associated_paper: Bobbitt et al., 'MOFX-DB: An Online Reference Database', J. Chem. Eng. Data (2023)

name: Materials Project
description: Open database of DFT-computed properties (formation energies, band structures, elastic tensors, phase diagrams, X-ray spectra) for over 150,000 inorganic crystalline materials, plus molecules and battery electrodes. Data are generated by high-throughput VASP DFT workflows.
associated_paper: Jain et al., 'Commentary: The Materials Project', APL Materials 1, 011002 (2013)

name: Open Quantum Materials Database (OQMD)
description: Database of DFT-calculated thermodynamic and structural properties for over 1 million inorganic compounds, focused on formation energies, phase stability and convex hulls. Generated by high-throughput DFT calculations at Northwestern University.
associated_paper: Kirklin et al., 'The Open Quantum Materials Database (OQMD)', npj Comput. Mater. 1, 15010 (2015)

name: AFLOW (Automatic FLOW for Materials Discovery)
description: One of the largest computational materials repositories, with DFT-calculated properties for over 3.5 million compounds and hundreds of millions of properties, including thermodynamic, electronic, mechanical and thermal descriptors. Generated by automated high-throughput ab-initio workflows.
associated_paper: Curtarolo et al., 'AFLOW: An automatic framework for high-throughput materials discovery', Comput. Mater. Sci. 58 (2012)

name: JARVIS-NIST (Joint Automated Repository for Various Integrated Simulations)
description: NIST infrastructure and databases (JARVIS-DFT, JARVIS-FF, JARVIS-ML, JARVIS-Leaderboard) covering ~80,000 materials with ~1 million calculated properties spanning DFT, force fields, and ML models, plus some experimental references. Generated by automated simulation workflows.
associated_paper: Choudhary et al., 'The joint automated repository for various integrated simulations (JARVIS)', npj Comput. Mater. 6, 173 (2020)

name: Open Catalyst 2020 (OC20)
description: Large benchmark dataset for ML interatomic potentials in heterogeneous catalysis, comprising ~1.28 million DFT relaxations (~265 million single-point calculations) of adsorbate-catalyst systems across diverse surfaces with N, C and O chemistries. Generated by DFT.
associated_paper: Chanussot et al., 'The Open Catalyst 2020 (OC20) Dataset and Community Challenges', ACS Catal. 11 (2021)

name: Open Catalyst 2022 (OC22)
description: Extension of the Open Catalyst effort to oxide electrocatalysts, comprising 62,331 DFT relaxations (~9.85 million single-point calculations) across a range of oxide materials, coverages and adsorbates. Generated by DFT.
associated_paper: Tran et al., 'The Open Catalyst 2022 (OC22) Dataset and Challenges for Oxide Electrocatalysts', ACS Catal. 13 (2023)

name: Catalysis-Hub.org
description: Open electronic-structure database for surface reactions containing more than 100,000 chemisorption and reaction energies from DFT calculations, with surface geometries and calculation parameters, plus tools and a Python/GraphQL API. Generated by DFT (largely SUNCAT/Stanford).
associated_paper: Winther et al., 'Catalysis-Hub.org, an open electronic structure database for surface reactions', Sci. Data 6, 75 (2019)

name: Computational 2D Materials Database (C2DB)
description: Open database of structural, thermodynamic, elastic, electronic, magnetic and optical properties for ~4,000+ two-dimensional monolayers across more than 40 crystal structures. Properties are computed with DFT and, for select materials, many-body methods (G0W0/BSE) using GPAW.
associated_paper: Haastrup et al., 'The Computational 2D Materials Database (C2DB)', 2D Mater. 5, 042002 (2018)

name: 2DMatPedia
description: Open computational database of more than 6,000 two-dimensional monolayer structures obtained via top-down exfoliation screening of the Materials Project and bottom-up elemental substitution, with consistently calculated structural, electronic and energetic properties. Generated by DFT.
associated_paper: Zhou et al., '2DMatPedia, an open computational database of two-dimensional materials', Sci. Data 6, 86 (2019)

name: Matbench Discovery
description: Benchmark framework and leaderboard for evaluating ML energy models (interatomic potentials, one-shot predictors) on their ability to discover stable inorganic crystals via WBM/thermodynamic-stability tasks. Built on DFT reference data from the Materials Project ecosystem.
associated_paper: Riebesell et al., 'Matbench Discovery', Nature Machine Intelligence (2025)
